cover_letter.letter:
My name is Alex Gonzalez and I am eager to explore opportunities with forward-thinking organizations that are committed to pushing the boundaries of their respective fields.  With a diverse background in film, animation, vr, and web3 technology, I have had the privilege of leading professional projects and as of recent - blockchain development, all of which, I hope to bring a unique blend of creativity, leadership and technical expertise.

In my recent role as Creative Director at the software development company, ApeWorX, I led multiple teams, managing projects from conception to completion. This experience honed my skills in team management, product development, and stakeholder engagement. I did my best to serve as a leader who can effectively work with highly experienced (and opinionated) software engineers and help guide visions into tangible realities.

At ApeWorX, my role allowed me to blend technical acumen with creative flair, focusing on user-centric design while simultaneously having to adhere to technical constraints. I was privileged to work intatemently with its founder and was able to pursuit of maintaining the macro vision of the company’s existence among its various software products.

A key highlight of my tenure at Apeworx was spearheading the development of cHaOsNeT, a project that challenged my proficiency and intertwined itself with a necessity to explore emerging blockchain technologirs. My mission was to create a user-friendly virtual simulation platform, adept at replicating real-world blockchain environments for reliable smart contract testing.

In my dual role as the lead designer and front-end developer, I tackled the challenge of creating a sophisticated yet accessible user interface. This endeavor required a design of a workflow to ensure a seamless experience for users dealing with real money and potentially significant transactions in blockchain ecosystem simulations. This project played a crucial role in improving my skills in front-end development, design, team-building and the practical application of blockchain technology.

Outside of my professional work, I am actively involved in my community. I serve as an AV Captain and Podcast Engineer at my local church, where I contribute to the production of audiovisual content. Additionally, I hold the position of Digital Director of MA, which allows me to collaborate with individuals across the state, fostering connections and sharing knowledge.

Alongside my work in technology and design, I've also enjoyed sharing knowledge as an educator. I've served as an instructor and adjunct professor at acclaimed institutions, teaching courses in Digital Filmmaking, Animation, software design, and VR World Building. These teaching experiences have provided me with the opportunity to mentor and learn from students across multiple disciples and demographics. I aspire to continue teaching while pursuing a challenging role and hope that these educational endeavors compliment my professional pursuits, allowing me to share knowledge while staying connected with emerging talents and ideas.

Having recently transitioned from Apeworx, I am now a free agent, ready to embrace new challenges and opportunities. I am excited to contribute my experience from projects like cHaOsNeT to a fresh organization and I am enthusiastic about joining a culture that values technological innovation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and effective problem-solving.

I presently live in New Haven, CT, and am part of a colorful community of developers, artists, and a couple of yale postdocs on a mission, all of whom - keeps me connected and inspired.  I am looking for a role where I can leverage my diverse skill set and experience to make an impact.

I am eager to bring fresh energy, experience, and ideas and I am optimistic that my background aligns well with the current digital landscape, in which we dwell. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to innovative projects and am available for further discussions as need be.

Thank you for considering my work and past experience - I am excited about the opportunity to continue to contribute and would be happy to discuss anything.

Best,

Alex Gonzalez
